primitives.meaning: an authoritative record that a resumable process (checkout, application, quote, registration) opened for a person with at least one item and a resumable state
entryFilters: the identity behind the process resolves to a person we may contact
the process is still resumable in the system of record, with at least one item and a resume destination
no recovery instance is already open for this logical process
no payment failure is recorded on the process - a failed payment is FIN-134's, not abandonment
purpose-level permission for commercial recovery communication is recorded, and hard gates (GLB-31) allow it

primitives.asks: Can this process be recovered for this person at all?

branches.label: Eligible
branches.observes: process state, identity resolution, permission record
branches.test: the identity resolves to a contactable person, the process is resumable with items and a destination, no instance is open for it, no payment failure is recorded on it, and commercial recovery permission is recorded

branches.label: Not eligible
branches.observes: process state, identity resolution, permission record
branches.test: any of those fails - the reason is recorded as the no-action reason

primitives.does: Open the recovery instance against the logical process and start the abandonment clock from the last activity on it, not from when it opened. Activity before the first touch moves the clock; nothing after the first touch extends any window
